book.name: MATEO
book.title: SAN MATEO Maach peerdʌ haaujem Jesucristo higwia jöoi Mateoou p'ã pʌatarr

content: Juan chi hõor pör choomie t'õotarr
Mag Jesús nem k'ĩir pogk'e hõor dak'ĩir wau nʌrrʌm jaar hĩchab Herodeta Galilea durr reik'a sĩejim. Mag hag na hõrau nem hooba haajempa hich Jesuu wau sim sĩi bĩi wëjöm chi Herodeeu hũr hat'aawai
hich dʌ̈i hãbam degam k'ʌʌnag, —Maan Juan chi hõor pör choomie k'ararrta deeu hiiu p'iidʌwia mag nʌrrʌmgui hajim hanʌm; maguata mag hõor mor masim k'ʌʌnpa monaau nʌrrabahab hajim hanaabá.

Hirua mag sĩerran mʌga hajim haajem: Maata hich Herodeeu hich naam Felipe hʌʌi Herodías hanʌmta k'echeu hauwi sĩejim hanaabá. Mag hat'eeta Juanau chi reíg, “Pua pöd pʌch naam hʌʌi k'echeu hauwi pʌch hʌʌik'a hauju k'aba simgui” hajim hanʌm. Mamʌ sĩi hichig magbaawai warag Juan pʌr haupi jaauwi, cárcel deg p'ãar sĩupinaa cadenau jʌ̃ sĩupijim hanaabá.

Hichig mag hiek'atarr haawaita chi Herodeeu hi t'õopʌ̈im hiigjeejim hanʌm. Mamʌ t'umaam k'ʌʌnau Juanau Hẽwandam hiekta jaau sim k'ap'ʌ narr haawai, hirua t'õopʌ̈ik'iin, jũrr hõrau hichta k'aigbaju ha k'ĩirjuwia pöd t'õoba haajeejim haajem.
Mamʌ mag nʌm hee, biek hãb chi Herodes año cumpliitarr hag p'iesta k'a nʌm hee chi Herodías k'a jemk'ajim haajem, hõor k'apan t'ʌnʌm na. Mag hi jemk'a sim hoowia, hich Herodeeu k'õchk'a t'ʌnʌisiwi,
hich bãaurrag, “Pʌchdëu nem k'õsim mʌrʌg jëeubá; mʌch himeerba mua deeb k'aba deejugui” hajim hanaabá.

Mamʌ magbarm chi hãdaujã hũrtarr haawai hich chaai wawí sĩujim hanʌm. Magbaawai chi chaairau hich bãaurr jöoyag, “Magan mʌ hat'ee Juan chi hõor pör choomie pörta t'ëp hee haudeebá; jãata mua k'õsi hʌmgui” hajim hanʌm.
Mamʌ mag Juan pörta hichig jëeubaawai warre chi rey hök'ĩirjuu haadëjim hanaabá. Mamʌ hichdëu hõor t'ʌ̃rk'ʌʌitarr dʌ̈i hãbam mes gaai nʌmuata mag hichig jëeubarm nem deeju ha hiek'atarr haawai
chadcha Juan cárcel deg sĩerr haar hõor pʌ̈iwia t'õonaa, chi pör happai t'ëp hee waibëepi jaaujim hanaabá.
Magbaawai hi hipierr wëtwi, chadcha hichdëu jaautarrjö t'õonaa, chi pör t'ʌapnaa haibëewi, chi daupeer mag chi jemk'a sĩerrag deechëjierram haajem. Magbaa hichdëu jũrr hich hãdag deejim hanaabá.
Mag chi Juan hö t'ʌapbapʌ̈im habaawai, hi dʌ̈i wënʌrraajerr k'ʌʌndamau bëewi, harrwi, hauk'ërjierram hanaabá. Maimua ya mag hamau hi t'õobapäaiwaita maar haig Jesuug jawaan bëejierram.
Jesuu hõor cinco mil jãhogtarr

Mag Juan hö t'ʌap t'õobarm hich haar jaaubaimam hũrwia, hök'ĩirjugau warag chawag hõor chukag haar maju habaawai, marau hi joo harrjim. Pari mag wëtumua ya maar döjãrr paauk'abaadëm hõrau hoopʌ̈itarr haawai hag dak'a p'öbör nʌnʌidʌm heem k'ʌʌnau jũrr k'ʌd garmua maar na hërëubaadëjim.
Maimua ya jopimawia hooimaawai hi na hõor pöoma t'ʌnaajim. Magbaawai ham dau haug k'augwi ham haaunaanjã monaaupʌ̈imajim.
Mag nʌm hee, ya k'eeuraa haadeewai maach garmuata hirig, —Mʌg hõorjã chukag heeta ya k'eeuraa haadëm; hamag wëtpi jaaubá, p'öbör hee wëtwi hamach hat'ee k'öjudam për haumk'ĩir hanaajim.
Magbaawai, —K'öju jʌraanpai chan ham wëtju k'aba nʌm. ¿Jãg pãachdëuta ham jãhogbamma? hajim, hich Jesuu maachigta.
Magbaawai marau, —Maar k'öju chuk'u nʌmgui hajim hamag deeg. Hãba pandamta cinco wai nʌm dʌ̈i hãwarrdamta dau numpai wai nʌm hajim hirig.
Magbaawaita hichdëu, —Mak'ʌʌndam mʌ haig haipidut hajim.

Mag chadcha hich haig haipierrwai hõor pöm mag t'ʌnarrag, —P'ũak hee hohood habat hajim. Maimua mag pandam cinco narr dʌ̈i chi hãwarrdampa p'ë hauwia hʌ̃gt'aag heerpanaa, Hẽwandamag hag paar hʌ̈u hajim hanaa, hichdëupai chi pan t'orreunaa marag hʌapʌ̈imajim. Magbaawai jũrr maachdëuta hõrag jigmajim.

Mag jigmamua, jigmamua, hich hiiu haawai t'umaam k'ʌʌnau hamachdëu k'öm haig k'ötarrjã dʌ̈rr hapiwi, pan pöm sobjim, chi hãwarrjã hagjö. Mag chi sobtarr p'ë haunaa hoowai t'ʌbʌt k'apan docen hãb höbërjim chi hipiirk'am.
Mag hed mag Jesuu jãhogtarr k'ʌʌn chi k'apanag cinco mil naajim, hemk'ooin happai, hʌʌin beerba ni chaainjã beerba.
Jesús döjã hʌ̃r nʌrrarr
Mag hõor pöm t'ach k'öpiwi jũrr maachta hich na maach dʌrbagk'atarr jap hee wëtpi jaaujim, hich na t'oom higar naaimamk'ĩir. Maagwai hichin hagt'a hich haig sĩsijim hõor hoopäaiwai.
Maimua hõor t'um hërëuwia hich happai haadeewaita, hi hiek buchag gaai hich happai hich Hayag jëwaan majim haajem. Maagwai ya hedau k'ëubaadeewaijã mam hich happai chirajim haajem.
Magʌmich maran ya döjãrr naajim. Mamʌ maar k'ĩir garmuata p'ũ wë t'ʌnarr haawai maar japan p'ũasau höpp'ërta jiir hahau k'ajim.
Maimua ya hãspa hurumuata hich Jesús maar hẽudee bëejim. Pari mag hurumjã sĩi döjã hʌ̃rta jẽb t'etag gayamjö hurajim.
Mag döjã hʌ̃rta jẽb gayamjö maachig hurum hoobaawai jãp'ierrwi maar hähäi k'ap'öbaadëjim. Mag jãp'ierrnaa hähäik'amua, —Keena, hak'aar k'abahaba hanaajim marau.
Pari magbaawai hich Jesuu, —Keena, hoob jãp'ierrmiet; mʌ k'abahab hajim marag.
Magbaa Pedroou hirig, —Señor, chadcha pʌchta Jesús k'ai, magan mʌjã pʌchjö döjã hʌ̃r pʌch haar mapibá hajim.
Magbaawai hirig, —Bëejuma hajim Jesuu. Magbaawai chadcha Pedroou jap heemua waaidʌbaadëwi Jesús k'ĩirp'ee dʌdʌrgmaa hajim, döjã hʌ̃rta durramjö.
Pari p'ũas dau dapag hoowi jãp'ierrbaadëjim. Mag jãp'ierrbaadëm hee hĩchab ya hierrpamajim. Magbaawaita maach Pörög, —Señor, mʌ hoobahur, mʌʌn hierrpamamgui hajim.
Magbarm bʌ̈rre Jesuu hi jua gaai pʌrnaa, —¿K'ant'ee pua pʌch hierrpaju k'ĩirjujĩ? Jãgan pua chan mua pʌchig nem mag haawaijã mʌ hiek hʌ̈k'aba chirabma hajim hirig.
Maimua ya ham jap hee waaidʌtk'abaadee chi p'ũ meuu haadëjim.
Mag chi Jesús jap hee pabaadee hi k'ĩirp'ee kanieu p'õbk'anaa, —Chadcha pʌʌta Hẽwandam Hiewaau hanaajim, marau hirig.
Genesaretpien Jesuu monaauk'atarr
Mag wëtumua t'oom higar Genesaret durr p'ẽeubaimajierram.
Mag Jesús barbaimam hõrau k'augp'öbaadee, sĩi hag perás bĩi jöisijim. Mag hamachdëu k'augp'öbaadee hi haig hõor mor masim k'ʌʌn haibëenaa hirig,
—Maar haaunaanag pʌch k'ajũahidam gaaipai k'ãijã pʌrpibá haajeejim, monaaumk'ĩir. Mag chadcha t'um hi k'ajũa gaai pʌrmam k'ʌʌnan warre monaauk'a maajeejim, mag sĩi pʌrbarmuapai.
